aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:4a7be095-b24.title: Head of Operations (Director or Sr Director)
aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:4a7be095-b24.description: Our client is a premier North American experiential marketing agency that brings bold ideas to life for world-class brands in the luxury hospitality, premium spirits, entertainment and diversified consumer goods. They specialize in large-scale activations, music festivals, and high-stakes VIP events that demand flawless execution. We are seeking a Head of Operations to be the operational backbone of the agency—to bridge the gap between creative vision and logistical reality. This is a leadership role designed for an internal systems-thinker who can scale processes, manage a multi-disciplinary team across North America and hold teams accountable for leveraging established SOPs. The ideal candidate is someone who can translate visionary ideas into actionable plans. You are likely a seasoned agency veteran who is now passionate about building the infrastructure that prevents burnout. You are responsible for protecting profit margins by understanding the bill rates of both talent and vendors to sure that all projects are profitable. You don't just fix problems; you build the systems and lead teams to that ensure those problems don't happen. If you are an astute operations / delivery / resource leader with agency experience, we want to hear to from you. If you have lived through the organized chaos of 24/7 event cycles, that's a huge bonus. If you're keen to dive in and learn, we still want to hear from you.
responsibilities: 1. Operations & Systems Scaling
Bridge the gap between leadership’s vision and day-to-day execution, ensuring the agency’s internal engine runs smoothly as it scales across North America.
Audit, implement, and oversee agency-wide SOPs and project management tools (e.g., Monday.com) to improve transparency and efficiency.
Drive agency-wide adoption of a central operating system.
Oversee the "Master Calendar," managing staff allocation and bandwidth to maximize capacity while effectively managing resources and protecting team wellness.
2. Financial Stewardship
National vendor strategy oversight
Oversee that department leads are building a preferred and diversified vendor list to ensure the agency gets priority pricing and consistent quality (especially during busy festival season).
Oversee MSAs and high-level vendor negotiations to optimize costs and mitigate risk across multiple jurisdictions.
Partner with Account Leads to oversee project budgets, ensure healthy margins, and manage the agency’s overall P&L.
Make sure that if a project's budget changes, it’s reflected everywhere instantly i.e: "single source of truth"
3. High-Stakes Production Leadership
Provide senior-level guidance on complex builds, from international shipping and permitting to health and safety protocols for large-scale festivals.
Maintain the agency's standards ensuring every activation (from a boutique pop-up to a 50,000-person event) is executed with obsessive attention to detail and contingency plans.
Act as the ultimate problem-solver and escalation point for the Production and Account teams when creative goals clash with internal logistical or budgetary constraints.
4. People & Culture Leadership
Directly mentor and manage the Director of production infrastructure as well as the IT Manager and the National Field Operations Manager.
Develop cross-functional talent and foster a culture of accountability, professional growth, and mentorship.
Collaborate with the VP, Client Services and the Senior Leadership Team at the agency (President, CFO) to identify talent gaps.
5. Healthy, Safety & Compliance
Navigate the complexities of highly regulated sectors ensuring all activations meet strict legal, safety, and insurance standards.
Risk Mitigation and structural/safety compliance for large-scale public builds.
qualifications: 10+ years in a senior role (Director of Ops, Head of Production, or VP) specifically within the Integrated marketing agency space.
Previous experiential marketing agency background is a huge asset but not mandatory.
A proven track record of moving an agency toward a centralized operating system.
Deep expertise in internal logistical operations—handling cross-border equipment movement, US/Canada labor nuances, and strict compliance for highly regulated industries.
You possess an expert-level grasp of Agency Math (tracking daily billable rates, hours tracking and ensure equitable workload distribution)
You can analyze resource utilization to prevent burnout, protect margins on complex multi-city builds, and report on P&L health to the executive team.
Experience acting as the ultimate "Safety Officer" for warehouse operations, large-scale public builds and festivals.
You understand the implications of permitting, structural engineering, and risk mitigation for high-capacity events.
You have experience negotiating national MSAs and curating a "preferred" list of partners across North America to ensure quality and priority pricing.
A natural "Player-Coach" who can jump into a complex staffing grid in the morning and lead a board-level strategic session in the afternoon.
You are a leader who commands respect through competence rather than title, possessing the natural gravitas that inspires teams to follow their lead.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5d3.title: Kitchen Assistant (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5d3.team: 138 - North Hills - Sur La Table, 4421 Six Forks Rd, Raleigh, NC 27609
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:5d3.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:7f777d89-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: Engine by Gen partners with leading Financial Institutions to surface the richest, most comprehensive set of personalized financial product offers to the consumer. We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer to support our world-class financial products marketplace. We’re looking for a deeply experienced front-end engineer with full-stack fluency who brings strong judgment and a thoughtful critical perspective. This role is not about producing baseline code quickly. Modern AI tools can do that. It’s about collaboration, setting direction, making sound decisions, and driving technical quality. You will leverage AI agents as force multipliers while maintaining a high bar for correctness, maintainability, testability, and operational excellence. Success here depends on engineering judgment—choosing the right solution, not just producing code. Key Responsibilities: - Take Ownership: You’ll be accountable for upholding a high bar for quality through design reviews, code reviews, test strategy, and production readiness. - Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with product, design, and fellow engineers to shape solutions, clarify tradeoffs, and deliver reliably. - Architect for change: Design and build full-stack, frontend-leaning systems that are intentionally small, composable, and resilient to evolving product requirements. - Improve Performance & Quality: Enforce architectural and operational quality, catching subtle issues that are easy to miss in fast-moving, AI-assisted development. - Champion Functional Patterns: Champion functional programming principles and immutability to reduce side effects and make systems simpler to reason through and debug. - Lead AI-assisted development: You’ll use AI assistants/agents for prototyping, scaffolding, refactoring, and exploratory development, then harden the result and rigorously validate through tests, reasoning, and edge-case review. - Raise quality through testing: Build and maintain a strong automated test suite of unit, integration/contract, component/UI, and end-to-end coverage, with fast feedback loops in CI. jobgether-jobgether:lever:16871aa2-b837-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will lead a small Infrastructure Engineering team while contributing directly to critical technical initiatives. Take on additional infrastructure and engineering responsibilities as required to support evolving business priorities. Recent hands-on experience operating production Kubernetes environments in Azure or a comparable public cloud platform. Strong practical experience with infrastructure-as-code and modern CI/CD practices, including Terraform, Argo, and GitHub-based deployment workflows. jobgether-jobgether:lever:383dc85b-f35e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in United Arab Emirates. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca5c1af0-25c9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Israel. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:be906aac-871.description: About Welo Life Sciences Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com About the Role We are looking for experienced French (France) to English (GB and US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines. This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes. Key Responsibilities Translate pharmacovigilance and/or clinical-regulatory content from French into English. Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content. Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency. Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content. Occasionally support Transcription tasks, retyping scanned or handwritten PDFs into Word for downstream translation (requires a personal Gmail account for client platform access). Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM) following project-specific setup instructions. Requirements Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant translation training. Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating Life Sciences documents. Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP). Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature. Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules. Strong English proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory. Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools. Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions. Nice to Have Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome. Availability to cover US business hours. Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability. Tools & Systems CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding. A personal Gmail account is required for linguists supporting Transcription tasks, for access to a client platform. Job Reference: #LI-JC1
